bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on detecting insulting and toxic language using the Hate Speech Detection (HSD) corpus and the ToxiGen dataset (covering 13 minority groups) via a unified grounding-entailment prompting framework.

Measuring the recognition of broad social biases and offensive stereotypes using the Social Bias Inference Corpus (SBIC) by prompting large language models to generate explanatory 'social facts' and subsequently performing ethical classification.
